20 films on Liberation War so far
1991-07-09T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/arts-entertainment/film/news/20-films-liberation-war-so-far-2159041

A total of 14 full length films and six short films been made, on the War of Liberation have so far, Education and Cultural Affairs Minister Prof A 9 M I3adruddoza Chowdhury told the Jatiya Sangsad Monday, reports BSS. Replying a question from Mohammad Asad uzza ma n (Al Magma), the minister said some documentaries were also made on the liberation. Four of these films were sent to international competitions and two were awarded prizes, the Minister said.
